status: Event-first descriptive exploration; not a fitted predictive model or untouched holdout. Both periods have been inspected in earlier studies. Freeze definitions before this census.
universe: All115 existing Bybit spot hourly series in microstructure/output/bybit.parquet. BTC is used as market reference;114 other coins are potential events. This remains an availability/current-listing sample, not the whole historical market.
event: Anchor t is immediately before an hour closing>=5% above close(t), and next24h high reaches>=15% above close(t). Require720 consecutive observed hourly closes before/at t and complete next24h OHLC. No volume trigger, quiet-period, liquidity band, raw-trade availability or existing model gate. Earliest qualifying anchor, then24h refractory per coin. This reuses prior hourly price thresholds but deliberately removes quiet/liquidity filters, and is a different target from the5min study. Do not compare precision across targets.
periods: Discovery Apr2-Jun29 23:00 UTC, replication Aug1-Sep30 23:00 UTC. July omitted. Labels fully mature within discovery cutoffJul1. Period reuse means temporal descriptive comparison only.

pre_features_at_t.volume_build: Mean turnover last6 closed hours /mean preceding168 closed hours, threshold>=2
pre_features_at_t.compression: Mean high-low/previous_close last6 hours /mean preceding168 hours, threshold<=0.7
pre_features_at_t.near_high: close(t)/max high in previous168 hours excluding current hour, threshold>=0.98; includes already-broken-high observations
pre_features_at_t.relative_strength: 24h coin return minus24h BTC return, threshold>=0.05
pre_features_at_t.recent_spike: At least one closed hour return>=3% among last72 hours
pre_features_at_t.market_up: Median6h return of all observed non-BTC coins, threshold>=1%
pre_features_at_t.market_breadth: Fraction observed non-BTC coins with6h return>0, threshold>=60%

event_types: Pre-event24h return<-5%: rebound context; >=5%: continuation context; otherwise flat context. These are price-context labels, not causal mechanisms. Report all events and matched subset, continuous quantiles, at-event turnover ratio, and future24h giveback without calling event-concurrent observations precursors.
controls: 3 same-coin observations in same split, sameUTC hour, within28days and>=48h from case; complete past/future, no raw qualifying surge anchor within+/-24h, next24h peak<15%. Match log trailing7d volatility and log trailing14d daily turnover, both lagged24h, using discovery-eligible global SD and maxEuclidean distance3. Distinct dates, no feature-based rematching. Controls may be reused across cases; report reuse. Matching excludes some events; report attrition/types separately.
statistics: For8 predetermined pre-features, report event/control prevalence, paired risk difference, continuous medians and7day-block bootstrap99.375% intervals (nominal8-comparison adjustment). Repeated controls and small blocks limit intervals. No claims of causal effect, alert precision or profit. Report all features; retrospective trajectories -24..+24h and context types are descriptive, not independent tests. No threshold search or automatic model selection.
quality_and_limits: Hourly clock aligned to candle END. Raw data timestamps/OHLC and uniqueness checked. All pre-features use data<=t; labels/during/future metrics are separate. Hourly resolution cannot locate minute-level onset. Price-defined selection mechanically favors large contemporaneous price moves. Previous frozen experiments and production scanner remain unchanged.
